name: Skill Eval: planning-skills (issue #171)
description: Four-arm eval for planning-skills. Measures skill-vs-terse delta for architecture and task decomposition tasks. Run with: sin-code eval run --dataset evals/skill-planning.json --arm baseline,terse,lazy_skill,skill-planning-enterprise

test_cases.prompt: Break down the architecture for an enterprise e-commerce platform into service boundaries: inventory, checkout, payments, notifications, and analytics. Show the dependency graph and identify hot paths.
test_cases.description: skill-planning-enterprise should use sin_sckg for dependency graph analysis and sin_orchestrate for multi-service decomposition.

test_cases.prompt: Decompose a complex feature 'implement OAuth2 SSO with SAML fallback' into a DAG of implementation tasks with dependencies, effort estimates, and risk annotations.
test_cases.description: skill-planning-enterprise should use sin_sckg to map existing auth code and sin_orchestrate to schedule the task DAG.
